query: SELECT m.id, m.ifoodProductName, p.name as productName FROM ifoodProductMappings m LEFT JOIN products p ON m.productId = p.id WHERE (m.ifoodProductName LIKE '%coca%' OR p.name LIKE '%coca%') LIMIT 10;
